children.text: The Taiwan tourist visa allows the holder a short-term tourist visit to Taiwan.
There are 2 ways for Georgian citizens to apply for a Taiwan visa:
Visiting the consulate in Ankara, Turkey, or 2. A remote process, with the help of our consultant's representative.
To apply for the Taiwan visa in person, you need to complete the visa application, prepare the documents, and contact the Taiwan consulate to book an appointment.

content.text: If you apply through a representative in Turkey:

children.text: In this case, an authorized representative contacts the consulate on the applicant's behalf; the documentation is sent to them via courier service. The representative will complete the visa application form themselves and visit the consulate, along with the documents you provided, to submit the documentation.

children.text:

To apply, the following steps must be completed:

page.title: What is the process for obtaining the visa?

children.text: Processing of the Taiwan visa application begins once the documents are submitted, and takes up to 7 days. If you do not submit the application in person, this period is extended by the time needed to send and return the documentation.
The visa is valid for 3 months, with a single entry and a stay of up to 45 days.

page.title: How long is the visa valid?

children.text: Confirmation of the consulate appointment booking
Visa application form
A valid passport (valid for at least 6 more months)
Flight reservation
Proof of accommodation
Employment letter
Additional documentation (invitation letter, motivation letter, and others)
Make sure to include all required information in your application.
Make sure your passport is valid for at least six months from your planned return date.
If you have additional supporting documents, submit them to the consulate translated and certified.
Apply for your visa at least 30 days before your trip, to avoid any possible complications.
The consulate reserves the right to request additional documentation from the applicant.
It's important to remember, and not exceed, the rights and obligations granted by your visa category.
